image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a printed paper menu. The text is heavily distorted and illegible, appearing as 'gibberish' or AI-hallucinated characters rather than real words. The layout mimics a standard restaurant menu with columns for items and prices, but the content is nonsensical. There are decorative elements at the top that resemble logos or headers, also rendered as unintelligible shapes.
